title: B.C. Conservative Leader Kerry-Lynne Findlay slams 'selfish' MLAs who left the party
summary: B.C. Conservative leader Kerry-Lynne Findlay says Ian Paton and Peter Milobar's decision to set up their own political party goes against the best interests of British Columbians.  Findlay insists her caucus is united even as Milobar and Paton warn that more could leave.

title: Search for B.C.'s best roadside attraction: Semifinal 1, Othello Tunnels vs. Cathedral Grove
summary: The story of British Columbia's complex relationship with our natural environment, our early attempts to control it, and our later attempts to celebrate it can be seen in the places voters have chosen to reach the final four of Search for B.C.'s Roadside Attraction.

title: Workers strike at Metro Vancouver waste-to-energy plant
summary: The union representing workers at Metro Vancouver's waste-to-energy plant says members have launched strike action against its employer.

title: Work begins to rebuild Port Coquitlam school destroyed by suspicious fire
summary: Nearly three years after Port Coquitlam's Hazel Trembath Elementary School was destroyed in a suspicious fire, work is beginning on its replacement.

title: B.C. real estate agent fined $200K, suspended after buying and renting out affordable housing unit
summary: A Victoria real estate agent has been fined $200,000 and had his licence suspended for six months after he bought an affordable housing unit and rented it out, according to a consent order posted by the B.C. Financial Services Authority.

title: How 50% U.S. tariffs will impact the average British Columbian
summary: While the average British Columbian isn't likely to see impacts at the grocery store immediately due to the punishing tariffs, an economist says it's likely that any Canadian counter-tariffs make their presence felt when residents look to buy goods in targeted sectors.

title: B.C. pulls out of plan for downtown Vancouver overdose prevention site
summary: British Columbia's newly appointed health minister says he has directed Vancouver Coastal Health to stand down on a plan to establish a new overdose prevention site in downtown Vancouver, a move applauded by the mayor.

title: Man who killed family of 6 on camping trip in 1982 denied parole
summary: David Ennis shot and killed George and Edith Bentley; their daughter Jackie Johnson; son-in-law Bob; and grandchildren Janet, 13, and Karen, 11, all from Kelowna, B.C, while they camped at Wells Gray Park near Clearwater in 1982.

title: After e-scooter death, Kamloops resident wants city to withdraw from B.C. pilot program
summary: A Kamloops, B.C., resident has started a petition asking city council to withdraw the city from a provincial pilot program allowing electric kick scooters.

title: Victim of Prince George plane crash identified as devoted coach, volunteer and mother of 2
summary: Alex Garneau was an athlete, coach and volunteer involved in many sports throughout Prince George, B.C.. The mother of two was killed when a plane made an emergency landing on a busy road, hitting her vehicle and three others. The investigation is ongoing.
